description: Source code for MPU9250 sensor trigger handling in Zephyr OS, including interrupt setup, callback handling, and threading mechanisms.

methods.name: mpu9250_trigger_set
methods.description: Configures the data ready trigger for the MPU9250 sensor, enabling or disabling GPIO interrupts based on the trigger type.

methods.name: mpu9250_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO interrupt callback that disables the GPIO interrupt and signals the thread or work to handle the event.

methods.name: mpu9250_thread_cb
methods.description: Handles the data ready event by invoking the registered handler and re-enabling GPIO interrupt.

methods.name: mpu9250_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes the GPIO interrupt for the MPU9250 sensor, setting up callbacks and enabling data ready interrupts.
